boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Oregon State University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Corvallis food stops with publicly posted evening hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 4825 SW Research Way, Corvallis
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a food option after most evening dining has ended; check the posted day-specific schedule before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A drive-thru option with the latest verified hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service until 3:00 AM Sunday through Thursday and 4:00 AM Friday and Saturday at 4825 SW Research Way.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 4825 SW Research Way, Corvallis
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru hours are posted as 7:00 AM–3:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 7:00 AM–4:00 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Pizza Hut
cards.subtitle: 700 NE Circle Blvd, Corvallis
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order for an evening pizza run; the official location page posts midnight carryout hours on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Carryout and delivery pizza with midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists carryout hours until 11:00 PM Sunday through Thursday and midnight Friday and Saturday at 700 NE Circle Blvd.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut Takeout — 700 NE Circle Blvd, Corvallis
cards.access_notes: Posted carryout hours are 10:30 AM–11:00 PM Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 AM–12:00 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Chick-fil-A Pacific Hwy & Circle
cards.subtitle: 350 NE Circle Blvd, Corvallis
cards.notes: Plan this stop for Monday through Saturday evenings, using the drive-thru if you arrive after the dining room’s posted closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Monday–Saturday drive-thru option until 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A lists this Corvallis location’s drive-thru open until 10:00 PM Monday through Saturday; it is closed Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The posted drive-thru schedule is 6:30 AM–10:00 PM Monday–Saturday; dine-in and carryout end at 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Castor Kitchen & Bar
cards.subtitle: 458 SW Madison Ave, Corvallis
cards.notes: For a later sit-down meal downtown, use the restaurant’s published dinner schedule and confirm seating availability directly before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Downtown dinner service with a posted 9 PM close and later Recess hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Castor lists dinner until 9:00 PM Monday through Saturday and Recess service until 10:00 PM on listed days.
cards.access_notes: The official site posts Recess until 10:00 PM Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday–Saturday after dinner; dinner runs until 9:00 PM Monday–Saturday.

cards.title: American Dream Pizza — Campus
cards.subtitle: 2525 NW Monroe Ave, Corvallis
cards.notes: Use the campus-area location for dine-in, takeout, or delivery; its posted schedule keeps food service available later on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A campus-area pizza stop open until 11 PM on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: American Dream Pizza’s official menu lists its Campus location open until 10:00 PM Sunday through Thursday and 11:00 PM Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: American Dream Pizza Corvallis menu and hours
cards.access_notes: Campus hours are posted as open daily from 11:00 AM, closing 10:00 PM Sunday–Thursday and 11:00 PM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: American Dream Pizza — Downtown
cards.subtitle: 214 SW 2nd St, Corvallis
cards.notes: Order food at the downtown location when its late-week schedule fits; use the venue’s current ordering page to confirm service before your trip.
cards.short_summary: Downtown pizza with an official ordering page showing 11 PM Friday and Saturday service.
cards.evidence_claim: American Dream Pizza Downtown’s official ordering page lists food ordering until 11:00 PM Friday and Saturday, 9:45 PM Thursday, and 8:45 PM Sunday through Wednesday.
cards.source_title: American Dream Pizza Downtown — order online
cards.access_notes: Official ordering hours list Friday and Saturday service through 11:00 PM; hours vary the rest of the week.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza on NW 9th
cards.subtitle: 1420 NW 9th St, Corvallis
cards.notes: Choose carryout or delivery from the NW 9th Street location when you need an orderable option around midnight; check the live store page first.
cards.short_summary: Pizza delivery and carryout with a verified midnight close.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official location materials list the 1420 NW 9th Street Corvallis store open until 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Domino’s location materials list this store open until 12:00 AM; store hours can vary, so verify the live listing before ordering.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza on NW Monroe
cards.subtitle: 2455 NW Monroe Ave, Corvallis
cards.notes: Use the Monroe Avenue store for delivery or carryout when its later posted closing time works for your evening; confirm the current store schedule online.
cards.short_summary: A second Corvallis Domino’s location listed until 1 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official location materials list the 2455 NW Monroe Avenue Corvallis store open until 1:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Domino’s Corvallis location materials identify the Monroe Avenue store as open until 1:00 AM; confirm live ordering availability before leaving.

cards.title: del Alma
cards.subtitle: 136 SW Washington Ave, Corvallis
cards.notes: Book or walk in for a downtown dinner on a night when the posted 9:30 PM Friday–Saturday close suits your plans; reservations are encouraged.
cards.short_summary: A downtown restaurant serving dinner later on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: del Alma lists dinner from 5:00 PM to 9:30 PM Friday and Saturday and until 9:00 PM Tuesday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Dinner hours are posted as 5:00–9:00 PM Tuesday–Thursday and 5:00–9:30 PM Friday–Saturday; the restaurant says reservations are encouraged.

cards.title: Five Guys
cards.subtitle: 845 NW 9th St, Corvallis
cards.notes: Use this NW 9th Street stop for an evening burger, fries, or shake; check the location page for that day’s closing time and available service.
cards.short_summary: A Corvallis burger and shake stop that posts a 10 PM close.
cards.evidence_claim: Five Guys’ official Corvallis location page lists the restaurant at 845 NW 9th Street as closing at 10:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: The official location page states that the Corvallis store closes at 10:00 PM; verify the day’s hours before traveling.
